team.name: Meenakshi Sundaram
team.bio: Leads the studio's architecture. Believes every house needs a thinnai, a mutram and at least one argument about where the pooja room goes.

team.name: Karthik Raman
team.bio: Directs interiors and renovation. Can identify an Athangudi pattern from across the room and a fake teak door from across the street.

team.name: Divya Natarajan
team.bio: Builds the Blender pipeline and every 3D model on this site. Has rendered more kolams than she has drawn — and she draws one every morning.

team.name: Senthil Murugan
team.bio: Advises on courtyards, cross-ventilation, rainwater and lime. Considers the electricity bill the most honest review of any design.

principles.title: Keep before adding
principles.text: Every project starts with a list of what already works — a teak door, a brick wall, a breeze from the east.

principles.title: Climate first
principles.text: Verandahs, courtyards, thick walls and clay roofs before air conditioners.

principles.title: Local hands, local materials
principles.text: Athangudi tiles, teak, granite, brass and lime — made by craftspeople within a day's drive.

principles.title: Three generations, one house
principles.text: Plans that work for the paati, the parents and the kids — steps, light and privacy included.

principles.title: One model, one truth
principles.text: Drawings, renderings and the 3D walkthrough come from the same model, so they never disagree.

process.title: Pesuvom
process.text: Let's talk. Site visit or call, a brief over filter coffee, and a measured survey.

process.title: Varaivom
process.text: We draw. Layout options, a first 3D model you can walk around, and a material direction.

process.title: Thittamiduvom
process.text: We plan the details: plans, sections, joinery, lighting and finishes, with costs checked as we go.

process.title: Kattuvom
process.text: We build. Contractor selection, site visits and samples approved in place — no surprises.

process.title: Graha Pravesam
process.text: Housewarming. Handover, a maintenance guide and, if invited, we bring the sweets.

history.text: Started in a Mylapore garage with one drafting table and a very patient landlord.
First new courtyard house; interiors and architecture brought under one roof.
Visualisation moves in-house with a Blender pipeline — clients start 'walking' their houses before construction.
Launch of this interactive portfolio, built from a single generated 3D model.
